messages:
deploybot: Alert: runtime v3.2.2 -> model group 'llama3q-quant' auto-pinned due to canary failures (signature mismatch). Pin applied to canary pools at 02:10 UTC. See /deploy/logs/1761112223.

natalie: quick summary? who saw what in canary?

ryan: repro: certain long-seq requests hit `kernel_bind_error` after SDK upgrade. Minimal repro: ```python
# repro snippet
resp = client.infer(model='llama3q-quant', input='x'*2000)
# traceback: RuntimeError: kernel_bind_error: incompatible binding v2 -> expected v1
```

pete: is it the SDK or runtime ABI? sounds like a binding shape change in SDK.

maria: deploybot only pinned canary pools. Do we want to widen to global pinned runtime v3.2.2->v3.1.9 until fix? Customer-facing docs will need a short note if global.

ryan: root cause is SDK serialized call frame included a new `kv_flags` field that runtime v3.2.2 didn't accept for quant kernels. SDK PR 8290 rolled this in. Rolling back the SDK is possible, or we can hotpatch the runtime to accept the extra field.

devex: if we go global pin we should publish a brief "compatability advisory" with recommended pinned versions and ETA for fix. Can take a 10min blurb.

opsbot: Scheduled action: maintenance window 03:00-04:00 UTC to deploy runtime shim to hosted. If rollback invoked, playbook RB-21 will be used. Pin TTL currently 8h.

natalie: proposed plan: 1) deploy a tolerant shim in runtime during 03:00 window, 2) deploy SDK rollback to stable tag if shim not ready, 3) keep pin TTL 8h, monitor error-rate and p95 latency for 20m, 4) if errors >0.8% over 5m or p95 +300ms for 15m, trigger RB-21 to revert to v3.1.9 and notify customers. Thoughts?

ryan: fine. I'll coordinate the shim deploy and monitor. Shim requires kernel reload: `systemctl restart runtimesrv-quant` on each host. I'll have a one-liner runbook ready.

pete: add an infra guard: don't remove pin until canary 30m stable after shim. Also add a manual approval step to widen to global.

maria: agree. I'll draft the release note: "Temporary runtime pin for llama3q-quant: routing to v3.1.9 due to SDK/runtime binding incompatibility. We are deploying a shim; customers may see transient increased latencies during the fix window." Will post for review in #product-docs once done.

devex: wording suggestion: include exact affected API surface + workaround snippet for customers using self-hosted SDK.

opsbot: Alerting set: error-rate threshold 0.8% (5m), p95 delta 300ms (15m). Pager escalation to SRE-oncall on hit.

natalie: assigning owners: ryan -> shim deploy + kernel reload, pete -> canary monitoring & approval, maria -> release note, devex -> customer blurb and SDK rollback guide. We'll use RB-21 if thresholds hit. Keep this thread for postmortem.

deploybot: Pin TTL confirmed 8h. Canary pin applied at 02:10 UTC. Maintenance window created. Auto-escalation disabled until manual approval to widen.
